risks.title: Leverage
risks.score_rationale: The company's leverage may negatively impact its ability to finance operations and repay debt. The report states that the company may be unable to access debt and capital markets, which could adversely affect its growth strategy and financial results.

risks.title: Liquidity
risks.score_rationale: The company's liquidity is essential to meet its cash requirements. The report states that the company may be unable to liquidate its assets quickly if needed, which could negatively impact its ability to repay debt.

risks.title: Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: General economic conditions may negatively impact the company's financial results. The report notes that economic conditions fluctuate and concerns remain regarding unfavorable macroeconomic conditions, such as inflation and interest rate volatility.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risks related to its loans and guarantees. The report states that the company has guaranteed financing for certain tax reserves, insurance, and non-compliant properties related to the financing of one of its joint ventures.

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to market risks related to competition and price volatility. The report states that the company faces risks related to fluctuations in home prices and competition in the rental market.
